# This is NOT the exceptions list. plane-reference-exceptions.txt is for references that
# are correct and may stay forever (our own package namespace, license headers, the docs
# links we deliberately kept) - an entry there is a decision, made once, done.
#
# This file is a debt ledger. Every line below is a known, already-reviewed reference to
# Plane infrastructure that is real and still unfixed - visible brand text with no link,
# or a link that's part of a larger, separately-scoped cleanup (e.g. the paid-tier upsell
# UI family: edition badge, upgrade modal, active-cycles paywall). An entry here is not a
# free pass, it's an IOU. This list should shrink as those cleanups happen, not grow as a
# place to dump anything inconvenient to fix under time pressure. See the audit report for
# what's tracked here and why. If a hit doesn't clearly belong in either file, it belongs
# in a report, not silently in this one.
# Regenerated via: node .github/scripts/check-plane-references.mjs --write-baseline
# Format: <file>\t<exact matched line, trimmed>
